title: Unique Games constraint template
statement: For a natural number $q$, the Unique Games template has domain $\{0,\ldots,q-1\}$ and predicates indexed by permutations of that domain. Each predicate has arity two and accepts an ordered pair $(a,b)$ exactly when the permutation sends $b$ to $a$.
